description: Permanently destroy an unread secret you created, so its link stops working (e.g. it was sent to the wrong place or is no longer needed). Irreversible. Returns { burned: true } if it was destroyed, or { burned: false, status } if there was nothing left to destroy because it was already read, burned or expired; if it was already read, the recipient has the value, so rotate the credential. Only works for secrets you created (needs their receiptToken). Free.

id.description: The secret's id, returned as `id` by ncrypted_create.

receiptToken.description: The creator's receipt token, returned as `receiptToken` by ncrypted_create. Only the creator has it; the link alone isn't enough.

name: ncrypted_burn
title: Burn one-time secret
